claimLevel: DEVICE_MEASURED (live MMFRuntime logcat on the phone wall clock, helper onset, graded runs, eyehole reads)
question: Can a full k3 Night 7 (10/20) carry the Cue Helper native frame trace -- per displayed frame times for the model's frameMs hook -- together with the live game log's office seed bracket?
method: Same launch as full-02 (tools/device/night-run.sh, k3 bundle, observe-once arm, MMFRuntime logcat streamed live). full-03 used night-run.sh --frame-trace (trace start at evidence.started). full-04 ran without that flag; a scratch watcher discovered the helper endpoint after custom-night.preset and sent TRACE start directly over a pre-opened adb forward once custom-night.start was logged (after the clock-stamp probe), and pulled the trace when the night ended.

runs.terminal: custom-night.start unstamped (cue-helper clock probe timed out) at 05:05:48.5Z, then campaign.abort.restart (spawnSync adb ETIMEDOUT) at 05:05:58.6Z; the game was relaunched to the title; no night was played

runs.cause: UNKNOWN. The trace start overlapped the Custom Night setup and its clock-stamp probe; that overlap is suspected, not proven. On the title screen, trace start alone answered OK trace=ACTIVE in 298 ms and adb round trips were 21-34 ms.

runs.terminal: lifecycle static at 05:15:47.249Z and gameover at 05:15:50.381Z, about 105 s after onset; death cause not identified (TERMINAL unknown). Gate 11 (gateAtMs 103000) was reached at phone wall 1789449348826, after the static, and aborted mask-state-unavailable; the 10 earlier gates agreed; every instrument passed.

frameTrace.start: direct TRACE start 20 ms after custom-night.start was logged; reply OK trace=ACTIVE in 24.5 ms
frameTrace.maxIntervalIs: the office load (black frames), 4.61 s into the trace

k3OnThePhone: 6 wins, 1 loss (full-04); full-03 was not a night. Not a cohort; a traced run is a measurement run.
notYetScored: The 13 candidates are not scored. Scoring needs a replay harness that feeds the trace's frame intervals to frameMs, places the k3 presses by cumulative real ms, and compares the model's office encounters with an eyehole read of full-04's video, which has not been run.
